# Plantjes. v1.0.1

**Patch release — 17 November 2026**

This patch release updates the bundled icon library used throughout the interface.

## Changes

- Updated `lucide-react` from 1.70.0 to 1.73.0.
- No application behavior, storage format, backup format, or security model changes.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing journals and `.plantjes` backups remain compatible.
- No action is required beyond loading the updated build.

Major framework and compiler upgrades are being reviewed separately and are not part of this patch.

For the full feature list, see the [Plantjes 1.0 release](https://github.com/Minprez-JP/Plantjes/releases/tag/v1.0).
